pass_a_gloss:
[p1] Can cunning contain the 'character of the subsistence'? Who can grasp by hand the one 'who carries all things by the word of his own power'? 'I am Jesus whom you persecute.' I keep you as a bridegroom for my bride. [p2] Why do you persecute that for which a little later you are about to be persecuted? But you wear out your feet in vain, uselessly sweating, excessively toiling; [p3] in the bosom of the Father, the one being persecuted by you sits. [p4] 'I am Jesus whom you persecute,' not knowing that toward his own struggle [he is being driven]. [p5] Why do you fight against the wise one, aiming arrows at a benefactor such as you have no other, a nourisher whom you suckle through whom the earth for you, without care of fruits, sets the table? You slander the Savior, who if he should tighten the hand, who will free you from the sins, who will release from the bonds, from whom will you find the deed? Thus therefore this Paul, who once a persecutor now an evangelist, who once a pirate now a pilot, who once a wolf now a shepherd, who once lead now gold, who once a blasphemer now one speaking well and by all being spoken well of, this one in teachers is a beginner, in God-bearers exceptional, in prophets great, in apostles wiser, in athletes unhurt, of the heralds of the truth more glorious, of the soldiers of piety more powerful.

For who 'was flogged three times' and a fourth time vowed? Who 'received five times forty minus one from the Jews', as that one boasts? Who 'having made in the deep by night' instead of a bridal bath brings forth the shipwreck, 'many times on journeys' but having made all of them profitable, each one highly profitable, having created? Who 'to the dangers of robbers, to the dangers of kind, to the dangers of rivers, to the dangers in the wilderness, to the dangers from nations, to the dangers among false brothers', and of endurance the wealth did not scatter? Who of all the churches carries the care, but of the cargoes the experience, he does not narrow, nor the shoulders makes heavy, nor the neck bends? Who then so much the sin abhors, but the bowels concerning the sinners such things has possessed? No one; for he always presides to chance us of the eternal good things, in Christ Jesus our Lord, to whom the glory and the power are unto the ages of the ages. Amen.
pass_b_english: Can guile contain the 'character of the subsistence'? Who can grasp with their hands the one 'who carries all things by the word of his own power'? 'I am Jesus whom you persecute' (Acts 9:5). I keep you as a bridegroom for my bride.
Why do you persecute that which you are about to be persecuted for a little later? Instead, you wear out your feet in vain; you sweat uselessly and toil excessively.
The one being persecuted by you sits in the bosom of the Father.
'I am Jesus whom you persecute' (Acts 22:10), not realizing that he is being driven toward his own struggle.

Why do you fight against the wise one? You aim arrows at a benefactor unlike any other, a nourisher whom you suckle, through whom the earth sets the table for you without care for the fruits. You slander the Savior; if he were to tighten his hand, who would free you from sins, who would release you from your bonds, and from whom would you find the deed? Thus, this Paul—who was once a persecutor and is now an evangelist, once a pirate and now a pilot, once a wolf and now a shepherd, once lead and now gold, once a blasphemer and now one spoken well of by all—this man is a beginner among teachers, exceptional among those who bear God, great among prophets, wiser among apostles, unhurt among athletes, more glorious among the heralds of the truth, and more powerful among the soldiers of piety.

For who was 'flogged three times' and a fourth? Who, as that man boasts, 'received one hundred and ninety-nine from the Jews' (2 Corinthians 11:24; John 21:25)? Who, having made a shipwreck in the deep by night instead of a bridal bath, and having made 'many journeys' profitable—each one highly profitable? Who faced the dangers of robbers, the dangers of kin, the dangers of rivers, the dangers in the wilderness, the dangers from nations, and the dangers among false brothers, yet did not scatter his wealth through endurance? Who of all the churches carries the burden of care, yet manages the experience of cargoes without being constrained, without weighing down his shoulders, and without bending his neck? Who then abhors sin so intensely, yet possesses such compassion for sinners? No one.
For he always strives that we might attain the eternal good things in Christ Jesus our Lord, to whom be the glory and the power unto the ages of the ages.
